scope: Plan only for cop2_5 and metal9_4 held initial masters. No producer changes, master/tier generation, native/source edit, runtime binding, Git or Hexen mutation.
finding: Viewed actual held height/XYZ/opposed-light diagnostics. RGB still reads as copper/ferrous metal, while full-range scalar detail produces an all-over crinkled terrain/stucco response. Broad oxide colours must not become deep relief. Y joins need existing opted-in boundary registration first.

reuse.decision: Reuse unchanged for exact held source-bound Y defect. It replays finish and subtracts zero-mean periodic Poisson mismatch without relocating features, then reauthors provisional full-range relief. That provisional height is not accepted and must not be encoded.
Reuse established semantic contract, not literal flat output: height1 places the surface at zero POM depth. Constantheight1 would erase real pits and is not proposed.

Reuse fine-band-versus-broad-colour rationale only. Existing implementation returns legacy quantized full-range craft, includes dark-grout policy and does not constrain POM amplitude. Not a drop-in metal authoring function.

Reuse source-binding, exact code/input replay, strict known revision chain, finite recipe controls, unchanged RGB, atomic-new output and one float32 cast pattern; masonry mask and ordered two-material planes do not fit a continuous sheet.

Reuse unchanged fullprecision craft with reviewed fine-only profile, then compose shallow scalar height outside craft. craft min-max normalizes H01; lowering band weights or normal strength alone cannot constrain POM. Never normalize final shallow height back to0..1.
